options.help: Each value is written to the server and never shown again, here or anywhere. Put credentials in a secret under Access › Secrets, not in an option, and choose it as the storage secret.
options.keyTwice: Another option has the key {{key}}; give each its own.

create.title: Create environment
create.name: Name
create.nameHelp: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens read best, such as staging.
create.nameDot: A name cannot hold a dot.
create.rootMissing: Say where its data is stored.

examples.file: A folder on the server, such as file:///srv/lakana/dev
examples.s3: A bucket and prefix, such as s3://bucket/prefix
examples.abfs: A container and prefix, such as abfs://container@account.dfs.core.windows.net/prefix

create.protect: Protect it: refuse deleting it and changing its storage
create.held: Name it and say where its data is stored.

retention.title: Set retention of {{name}}
retention.rule: Tables that set no retention of their own
retention.daysHelp: 1 to 3,650 days after a table's last write or read.
retention.held: Give a number of days from 1 to 3,650.
retention.onlyOff: A protected environment keeps its tables: only turning the retention off is possible.

storage.title: Change the storage of {{name}}
storage.secretNoneHere: This environment has no secret yet. Add one under Access › Secrets.
storage.keepOptions: Keep the options as they are
storage.replaceHelp: Sending replaces every option: name each one the storage needs.
storage.held: Choose another secret or replace the options.
storage.secretNeedsRight: Choosing the storage secret needs the right to manage secrets in {{name}}.

delete.title: Delete environment {{name}}?
delete.body: Its tables are dropped, the grants, row filters and masks on it are revoked, and its task tokens stop working.
delete.keep: Keep the files for the undo period, so it can be restored
delete.purge: Delete the files at the next clean-up. It cannot be restored.

restore.title: Restore {{name}}?
restore.body: Its tables come back with the grants, row filters and masks they had. Task tokens it had stay revoked.

purgeFiles.title: Delete the files of {{name}} now?
purgeFiles.body: The next clean-up deletes its tables' files, and it can no longer be restored.

removeRows.title: Remove {{name}} from the catalog?
removeRows.body: Lakana cannot reach this storage. This removes the environment's records and frees its name; files, if any, stay where they are.
